answer_1.quote: We introduce a novel task, designated as fMRI2text, which is the first open-vocabulary task that decodes fMRI time series into human language in a naturalistic context.
answer_1.outputs: The task is to decode the corresponding text tokens W := {w 1 , w 2 , ..., w n } of the stimuli used during the acquisition of the fMRI volumes from an open vocabulary V.

answer_2.quote: We follow the same evaluation strategy as Wang and Ji (2022) to establish a fair comparison and gain insights into the optimal performance scenario of UniCoRN.
